name: Value line settles into the lockup
looks: A short value statement with a small checkmark bullet holds on a dark ground, then cuts to the closing lockup: the mark and wordmark settle together, a one-line tagline fades in underneath, and the card holds still as the film ends.
build: The value line's checkmark circle pops in a beat before the text fades up beside it. Hard cut to the lockup card; mark and wordmark arrive together (`y:10px -> 0`, power2.out, ~350ms), tagline fading in 180ms after.
sound: A soft confirm tick on the checkmark, a low swell fading out under the final lockup hold.
prompt: Hold a short value statement with a small checkmark bullet on a dark ground, then cut to a closing lockup where the mark and wordmark settle together and a one-line tagline fades in underneath, ending the film on a calm, static card.
